about:
I am a third-year Computer Science Engineering student at Chaudhary Charan Singh University, Meerut, passionate about software development and problem-solving.

I enjoy learning Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) and building web applications using technologies like C++, JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.

I have worked on projects such as an Electrical Shop Management System and a School Management System, which have helped me strengthen my practical development skills.

I am continuously improving my problem-solving abilities and exploring backend development, REST APIs, databases, and scalable software systems.

My goal is to become a skilled software engineer and contribute to building useful, reliable, and efficient applications.
